tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search open roles at startups that raised venture money in the last six months. Same filters as the justbacked.com board. Members see roles the day they are posted. Returns jobs with title, company, location, pay, latest round, investors and apply link, plus total matches and a board_url to share.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Full detail for one role: description, pay, the company's latest round and investors, hiring velocity, apply URL, which hiring system (ATS) it uses, and whether it is already in the user's tracker.

tools.name: get_application_form
tools.description: The role's application questions (labels, types, required, options) read from the company's public Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby job board, so you can draft answers for the user to review. Read-only: it never submits anything. The user applies at apply_url.

tools.name: get_company
tools.description: A startup's profile: latest round, amount, date, lead investors, headcount, HQ, hiring velocity by function, and every open role.

tools.name: track_application
tools.description: Add a role to the user's JustBacked tracker (shown at justbacked.com/saved) or update its status. Statuses: saved, applied, interviewing, offer, rejected, withdrawn, archived. Use "saved" for roles the user is considering; use "applied" only after the user confirms they submitted. For a role found e

tools.name: list_applications
tools.description: The user's application tracker: every saved or applied role with status, applied date and notes, plus counts by status.

tools.name: update_application
tools.description: Change a tracked role's status (e.g. interviewing, offer, rejected, withdrawn), replace its notes, or append a dated note.

tools.name: list_lists
tools.description: The user's company lists (target companies) with each company's open roles and new roles this week. A list id also works as list_id in search_jobs.

tools.name: add_to_list
tools.description: Add a startup to one of the user's lists. Pass list_id, or list_name (an existing list's name, or a new list to create). Lists with alerts on email the user when a company posts a role or raises.

tools.name: remove_from_list
tools.description: Remove a startup from one of the user's lists.

tools.name: list_saved_searches
tools.description: The user's saved searches (email alerts) with their filters and board links.

tools.name: save_search
tools.description: Save a search with the same filters as search_jobs. JustBacked emails new matching roles instantly (as soon as they reach JustBacked), daily or weekly.

tools.name: delete_saved_search
tools.description: Delete one of the user's saved searches by id.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The user's membership, API usage today and tracker/list/search counts.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_job, get_application_form, add_to_list, list_saved_searches, save_search · Public sink: search_jobs, add_to_list, list_saved_searches · Destructive: remove_from_list, delete_saved_search.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_job, get_application_form, add_to_list, list_saved_searches, save_search · Public sink: search_jobs, add_to_list, list_saved_searches · Destructive: remove_from_list, delete_saved_search

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
